title: Record the printed E7 generator span
body:
## Summary
- The seven printed generators `256, 128, 66, 36, 22, 8, 1` are linearly independent and span 128 vectors in `F2^9`.
- Their overlaps with 7 are even, even, odd, odd, even, even, odd. The hyperplane of even overlap with 7 has 256 points, and the span meets it in 64.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
